shortDescription: Europe needs more long-term contracts for seaborne gas supply to hedge against soaring prices, according to Bloomberg, citing the head of Swiss energy company MET Group.The company said Europe should secure more LNG under longer-term deals to reduce exposure to energy shocks.

title: GEOPOLITICS | MET Says Europe Needs More Long-Term LNG Contracts
